description: This source file implements a plugin class 'IsoImagePlugin' for the 'wic' build system. The plugin creates a bootable ISO image, including configurations for legacy (syslinux) and EFI (grub-efi) boot loaders, handling initramfs creation, and ISO filesystem assembly. It provides methods for partition preparation, configuration, disk installation, and supporting functions like syslinux and grub-efi configuration.

classes.name: IsoImagePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class to create a hybrid, bootable ISO image supporting legacy and EFI boot modes.

methods.name: do_configure_syslinux(cls, creator, cr_workdir)
methods.description: Creates syslinux configuration file for legacy boot.

methods.name: do_configure_grubefi(cls, part, creator, target_dir)
methods.description: Creates grub-efi configuration file for UEFI boot.

methods.name: _build_initramfs_path(rootfs_dir, cr_workdir)
methods.description: Generates or locates the initramfs image.

methods.name: do_configure_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Sets up partition-specific configuration, such as image naming.

methods.name: _install_payload(source_params, iso_dir)
methods.description: Copies payload files into the ISO directory.

methods.name: do_prepare_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Prepares the partition with necessary files, configuration, and bootloader setup for ISO creation.

methods.name: do_install_disk(cls, disk, disk_name, creator, workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Finalizes the disk image, applying isohybrid to make it bootable from BIOS/UEFI media.
